options.text: Change is successful only when the new way is actually adopted and sustained
options.rationale: Correct: go-live is a milestone; adoption and reinforcement follow.

options.text: Celebrations are forbidden in change projects
options.rationale: Recognition is fine; the issue is measuring success too early.
